# nnp remaining original proof source and historical body archive

190 original bodies, 35 code files. Original remaining RW, MCSP, THR2 and authorized shared source/proof/body records preserve stopping gates and conditional claims. No new proof, actual RW witness or P versus NP conclusion is accepted. Four named historical inputs remain bounded-not-found in nominated trees and scoped accessible-ref history; no generator was executed to replace them. DRAT certificates have a separate exact-byte archival batch and no logical verification was performed.

This REVIEW checks archival scope and original byte preservation, not mathematical validity or fresh computational truth. Existing human/AI attribution and own original text/data CC BY4.0/code Apache2 grants apply; citations retain source rights. Exact source/public hashes, locator projections and historical status remain explicit. No research code, solver or proof checker was executed.
